page.content:
Bird is an Irish human golfer who appears in Mobile Golf. His name could either be derived from the golf term "birdie," which he often gets while playing, or from having a nose shaped like a bird beak.

page.overview:
Who is Bird?

Bird is an Irish human golfer who appears in Mobile Golf. His name could either be derived from the golf term "birdie," which he often gets while playing, or from having a nose shaped like a bird beak.
